title: Point
description: Plite point types and editor point reads.
---

A point combines a text path with a UTF-16 offset. Pure helpers live on
`PointApi`; editor-owned reads live under `editor.read.points`.

See the canonical [Point reference](/docs/plite/api/locations/point).
